rationale: This candidate proposes source-registry changes and documentation corrections only. It proposes no change to Runtime/stable behaviour, Router modules or adaptive tooling, so no provider-backed arm comparison is required to accept it. The required_eval_arms field is retained for schema compatibility and is not exercised by this candidate.

cases.name: Patch applies and is reversible
cases.method: Dry-run source-registry.patch.json against Research/sources/registry.json; confirm every add/update/retire id resolves and a rollback manifest restores the pre-patch file byte-for-byte.
cases.pass_criteria: All entries apply; rollback reproduces the original registry.json hash.

cases.name: No stable document cites a retired URL
cases.method: Grep Runtime/stable/, Core/, Claude/, Codex/, Shared/, Setup/ and both BOOTSTRAP files for each retired URL.
cases.pass_criteria: Zero references, or every reference is updated to the replacement URL in the same promotion diff.

cases.name: Dead agent-loop link is repaired
cases.method: code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-loop returns 404 and moved to /docs/en/agent-sdk/agent-loop. Verify no repo artifact still points at the 404 path.
cases.pass_criteria: All occurrences updated; link check returns 200.

cases.name: Corrected claims reconciled against existing contract text
cases.method: For each of the 31 'corrected' claims, diff its corrected_statement against the corresponding assertion in Claude/OPERATING_CONTRACT.md and Codex/OPERATING_CONTRACT.md; list contradictions.
cases.pass_criteria: Every contradiction is either fixed in the promotion diff or explicitly deferred with a reason.

cases.name: Version-sensitive sample re-verification
cases.method: Randomly sample 15 of the 242 accepted version_sensitive claims and independently re-open the cited tier-1 source at promotion time.
cases.pass_criteria: >=14/15 still supported. Any failure blocks promotion of that bucket pending full recheck.

cases.name: Rejected claims stay out of guidance
cases.method: Confirm none of the 4 unsupported claim ids appear in proposed-changes.md or any promoted text.

cases.name: Report source integrity
cases.method: Verify every source in the report's Sources appendix appears in claims.json or the patch, and that the rendered PDF exposes clickable URI annotations.
cases.pass_criteria: No orphan sources; PDF URI annotation count > 0.
